description: Agent-readiness report for one website, the same one people get at https://onlinewebdirectory.net/check: a score out of 100 and nine items (access, bot wall, JavaScript, robots.txt rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended, llms.txt, MCP server card, API catalog, x402 paid access, claimed or not), each with a state (pass, warn, fail, missing, unknown) and points. Free (10 a day, shared with lookup_origin): pass or fail and the score only. The full report costs 30 credits on a key (agent_token) from what is on file, 50 credits for a fresh look, or one x402 payment at GET /v1/check. Use it to tell a site owner what to fix; use lookup_origin before fetching a site yourself.

agent_token.description: Optional. Your key's read_token. With credits on the key you get the full report: 30 credits from what is on file, or a fresh look (50 credits) when there is no report from the last day.

host.description: Hostname to check, for example example.com. No scheme or path; www. and case are normalised.

name: check_domain
title: Score a website's readiness for AI agents
